candidate.guard_summary: No sanitization of href before substitution. encoder() function applied after substitution but before execv, but its purpose is unclear (likely encoding, not security). No shell escaping or parameterization used.
candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled href value directly substituted into shell command template via string replacement, then executed without sanitization
used_variable_sources: href (user URL input or temp file path)
path (editor command template or browser command template)
enclosing_conditions: if fetch: branch may modify href to temporary file path
candidate.context_summary: The _fork function substitutes href into a path template containing %u placeholder, then executes the resulting string as a shell command. Used for opening URLs in browsers and editing files with external editors.
unresolved_facts: Purpose and security effect of encoder() function
Whether href URLs are validated before use

target_cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended OS command when it is sent to a downstream component. This weakness can lead to a vulnerability in environments in which the attacker does not have direct access to the operating sy...
